dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Numerous closed 'O' and partial 'C' shaped light-pigmented perimeters exhibiting sharp gradient transitions against the dark exterior matrix. The ring perimeters are non-uniform, showing irregular, jagged geometric boundaries with varying thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily appearing as isolated punctate markings in the interstitial spaces between the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent central macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary arrangement of three smaller centroids in the posterior-dorsal region forms an obtuse triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly localized red-spectrum pixel saturation in the ocular region on the right side of the frame, creating a high-contrast color anomaly relative to the surrounding dark fur.
